subject: Welcome — Your Provider is Now In-Network
body:
Hello,

Great news. We are pleased to confirm that the following provider has been credentialed and is now in-network with Availity (DEMO):

Provider: Demo CAQH-Provider
NPI: 9999999991
Provider Number: AVL-PRV-3318274
Network Effective Date: June 1, 2026

The provider may begin seeing covered members on the effective date listed above. Please ensure billing systems and patient-facing scheduling tools reflect the new in-network status.

Attached is the welcome packet (PDF) with rate schedules, claim filing instructions, and contact info for ongoing provider relations support.

Thank you for partnering with us.

Availity (DEMO) Provider Network Operations
